Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the warm intro over the portal earlier. Harbor Systems is ready to get set up as a supplier for Redwood. To avoid delays to our implementation work, we'd like to confirm your PO and payment requirements so our billing team can format invoices correctly.

Quick overview: Harbor Systems (EIN on W9) provides telemetry connectors and professional services. Typical invoices for Redwood will be a mix of recurring platform charges and monthly services (usually in the $8k–$40k range).

Questions we have up front:
- Do you require a Redwood PO on every invoice? If so, is there a specific PO prefix we should include?
- What is Redwood’s standard net term (Net 30 / Net 45 / Net 60)?
- Do you offer early-pay discounts and, if so, what is the process to enroll?
- Any mandatory fields on invoices (company name, remit address, tax references, contact for disputes)?

Attached: Harbor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (completed), W9_HarborSystems.pdf, Harbor_bank_letter.pdf (ACH confirmation). Let me know if you need anything else.

Hi Susan —

Thanks for sending the form and the W9; I pulled the attachments into our intake queue. A few notes and requests from AP and procurement so we can complete setup without back-and-forth:

1) PO requirement: For Redwood, a PO is required for any invoice over $5,000. For now please include the PO field on every invoice; the PO prefix we use is HARB- (we’ll provide the numeric after purchase acceptance). If you want to test with a sample invoice header, attach it and I’ll confirm.

2) Standard terms: Our default for new vendors is Net 45. We sometimes make exceptions for subscription-only partners, but professional-services invoices generally use Net 45.

3) Early-pay: We do have an early-pay program. Typical enrollment offers 1.00% discount if invoice is paid within 15 days (Net45 baseline). If Harbor needs a faster window (e.g., 10 days) or a larger discount, we can evaluate through Finance; please state your preference.

4) Invoice fields: mandatory items are (a) Redwood Invoicing Name: Redwood Inference, Inc.; (b) PO#; (c) Invoice date; (d) Line-item descriptions and unit price; (e) Tax/EIN on W9 if applicable; (f) Remit to address or ACH details as supplied.

5) Bank/ACH: thanks for the bank letter — Finance will validate on Monday. If you prefer a secure upload, use the vendor portal here: https://vendor.redwoodinference.com/portal/upload.

Next steps: I’ll route your intake to AP for validation (David Kim), and Priyom will follow up on PO mapping and the portal onboarding flow. Expect an AP confirmation or a short validation list by Monday.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
